activities.description: The Interviewer inquires about the potential applications of holographic telepresence in education, imagining the future in 2030.

Brandon describes the concept of “holo universities” where faculty can teach from one central location to multiple satellite locations, reducing the need for travel and increasing access to education.

characterInteraction.description: The Interviewer leads the conversation, prompting Brandon to share his insights and vision for the future of education.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The discussion about reduced travel and increased access to education suggests that holographic telepresence can address current limitations and create a more equitable and interconnected learning environment.

Brandon’s answer paints a picture of a transformed educational landscape, highlighting the potential benefits of this technology.

scenes.title: Education in 2030

activities.description: The Interviewer questions the added value of holographic telepresence compared to traditional video conferencing, highlighting the novelty of the experience.

Brandon explains that this technology re-humanizes teleconferencing, creating a more engaging and memorable experience due to the lifelike 3D presence. He shares that clients have reported increased retention and engagement with holographic presentations, exceeding the impact of in-person interactions due to the “wow factor.”

characterInteraction.description: The Interviewer’s skeptical question sparks a detailed response from Brandon, creating a back-and-forth that explores the nuances and value of the technology.

scenes.contextualRelevance: Brandon’s answer implies a shift in communication paradigms, highlighting the potential for holographic telepresence to surpass the effectiveness of in-person interactions in certain contexts.

keyMoments.changeDescription: Visual shift as Brandon walks towards the camera, signifying a shift in the conversation towards a more personal and insightful response.

narrativeProgression.description: The Interviewer raises a crucial question, challenging the justification for holographic telepresence beyond its novelty.
Brandon addresses the concern by providing concrete evidence and insights, demonstrating the genuine value of this technology compared to traditional video conferencing.

scenes.thematicElements: Benefits of 3D presence, enhanced engagement and retention, re-humanization of teleconferencing, overcoming limitations of traditional video conferencing, the “wow factor” of holographic telepresence.
scenes.title: The Value of 3D Presence

activities.description: The Interviewer wonders whether the “wow factor” of holographic telepresence will eventually diminish and if this will become the new normal.

Brandon reaffirms his belief that this technology represents a significant departure from traditional communication methods and is here to stay. He highlights the transformative nature of the experience, suggesting that holographic telepresence has the potential to create a deeper sense of connection and understanding than flat-screen video conferencing.

characterInteraction.description: The Interviewer’s insightful question prompts Brandon to consider the long-term perspective and to reaffirm the value of holographic telepresence beyond its initial novelty.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The conversation acknowledges the natural tendency for humans to adapt to novel experiences, but argues that the inherent qualities of holographic telepresence will continue to offer a unique and valuable communication experience.

narrativeProgression.description: The Interviewer probes into the long-term viability and impact of the technology, questioning the potential for habituation to the “wow factor.”
Brandon’s answer reinforces the transformative nature of holographic telepresence, emphasizing its potential to redefine communication and learning.

scenes.thematicElements: Enduring impact of holographic telepresence, adaptation to new norms, potential for enhanced connection and understanding, future of communication and education.
scenes.title: The Future of Learning

activities.description: The Interviewer expresses his gratitude to ARHT Media and Brandon, acknowledging the value of the discussion and experience.
Brandon reciprocates the sentiment and beams the Interviewer’s hologram out, creating a visual effect to end the session.

characterInteraction.description: The closing exchange showcases mutual respect and appreciation between the Interviewer and Brandon.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The concluding exchange highlights the successful demonstration of holographic telepresence and mutual respect between the participants.

narrativeProgression.description: The Interviewer summarizes the key takeaways and expresses his appreciation for the experience.
The session concludes on a positive note, leaving the audience with a memorable visual of the holographic beam-out effect.
